title: Neither Precision Nor Architecture Alone: Controlled Tests of Failure Remedies for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.25327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) frequently fail on stiff or advection-dominated PDEs, and two recent accounts offer competing remedies: switching from FP32 to FP64 to repair an L-BFGS stopping artifact, or replacing the MLP with a state-space-model (SSM) backbone plus sub-sequence alignment to counter architectural simplicity bias. We test both under matched, seed-paired controls in a pre-registered 144-run study spanning convection, reaction, and wave, plus an independent 85-run convection/wave study; success is relative $\ell_2$ error below $0.05$. The two remedies act on disjoint regime-and-seed slices: neither substitutes for the other. On hard convection ($\beta{=}50$), alignment recovers 2/5 seeds in FP32 and 3/5 in FP64, where the unaligned SSM succeeds on 0/5 seeds at either precision and the vanilla MLP moves only from 0/5 to 1/5 across the precision switch---the recoveries trace to the alignment objective, not the back

translated_title: 既非精度也非架构单独作用：物理信息神经网络失败修复方法的受控测试
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在刚性或对流主导的偏微分方程上经常失败，近期两种观点提出了相互竞争的修复方法：从FP32切换到FP64以修复L-BFGS停止伪影，或用状态空间模型（SSM）骨干加子序列对齐替换MLP以应对架构简单性偏差。我们在预注册的144次运行研究中，采用匹配的、种子配对的对照，涵盖对流、反应和波动方程，外加独立的85次对流/波动研究；成功标准是相对ℓ2误差低于0.05。这两种修复方法作用于不相交的机制和种子切片：彼此不能替代。在硬对流（β=50）情况下，对齐在FP32中恢复2/5种子，在FP64中恢复3/5，而未对齐的SSM在任一精度下均未成功（0/5），普通MLP在精度切换时仅从0/5提升到1/5——恢复可追溯到对齐目标，而非后端。
tldr: 本研究通过受控实验证明，精度切换和架构对齐是物理信息神经网络失败修复的两种互补且不可替代的机制，各自作用于不同的失败场景。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates through controlled experiments that precision switching and architecture alignment are complementary, non-substitutable remedies for PINN failures, each addressing distinct failure regimes.
